title: Hydrodynamic Radii of Intrinsically Disordered Proteins: Fast Prediction by Minimum Dissipation Approximation and Experimental Validation.
authors: Waszkiewicz, Radost; Michas, Agnieszka; Bialobrzewski, Michal K; Klepka, Barbara P; Cieplak-Rotowska, Maja K; Staszalek, Zuzanna; Cichocki, Bogdan; Lisicki, Maciej; Szymczak, Piotr; Niedzwiecka, Anna
journal: The journal of physical chemistry letters
one_liner_zh: 该文用粗粒化模拟和最小耗散近似预测无序蛋白的流体力学半径，虽涉及IDP对象和物理模拟方法，但聚焦于扩散系数而非PPI互作机制，故得6分。
abstract: The diffusion coefficients of globular and fully unfolded proteins can be predicted with high accuracy solely from their mass or chain length. However, this approach fails for intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) containing structural domains. We propose a rapid predictive methodology for estimating the diffusion coefficients of IDPs. The methodology uses accelerated conformational sampling based on self-avoiding random walks and includes hydrodynamic interactions between coarse-grained protein subunits, modeled using the generalized Rotne-Prager-Yamakawa approximation. To estimate the hydrodynamic radius, we rely on the minimum dissipation approximation recently introduced by Cichocki et al. Using a large set of experimentally measured hydrodynamic radii of IDPs over a wide range of chain lengths and domain contributions, we demonstrate that our predictions are more accurate than the Kirkwood approximation and phenomenological approaches. Our technique may prove to be valuable in predicting the hydrodynamic properties of both fully unstructured and multidomain disordered proteins.
abstract_zh: 球状和完全未折叠蛋白质的扩散系数可以仅通过其质量或链长高精度预测。然而，这种方法对于含有结构域的内在无序蛋白质（IDPs）失效。我们提出了一种快速预测方法，用于估算IDPs的扩散系数。该方法基于自回避随机游走进行加速构象采样，并包含粗粒化蛋白质亚基之间的流体动力学相互作用，采用广义Rotne-Prager-Yamakawa近似进行建模。为估算流体动力学半径，我们依赖于Cichocki等人最近引入的最小耗散近似。利用大量实验测量的IDPs流体动力学半径数据，涵盖广泛的链长和结构域贡献，我们证明我们的预测比Kirkwood近似和现象学方法更准确。我们的技术可能在预测完全无结构和多结构域无序蛋白质的流体动力学性质方面具有重要价值。
